about: The legend quiz (WP-1.1, deferred to WP-4.7): a fresh agent given only spec/LEGEND.md and this clip answers ten fixed questions; nine right passes. Numbers are compared within 0.01, words without case.

questions.q: Does the clip loop? Answer yes or no.
How long is the clip, in seconds?
How many key poses does the clip have?
At t = 0, how far is the right elbow bent, in degrees?
At t = 0.267, how far is the right elbow bent, in degrees?
At t = 0, does the pelvis lean forward or backward? Answer forward or backward.
At t = 0.233, is the chest turned to the left or to the right of the pelvis? Answer left or right.
At t = 0, how high are the hips, in percent of standing hip height?
At t = 0.233, how many degrees does the right foot point down?
Does the clip travel (carry root motion)? Answer yes or no.
